# shadcn-base-kit

> All 61 shadcn/ui base-rhea components, the standardized pieces built on them, and a markdown twin of every file for an AI to read.

Every file under `src/` has a markdown twin below. Read the twin before you write against the file: it carries the exported names, the real signatures, the `cva` variants and the `data-slot` hooks, and it is regenerated from the AST so it cannot drift. `docs/` is generated by `node scripts/generate-docs.mjs`; the prose inside each `<!-- notes -->` block is hand-written and survives a rerun.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules that override your defaults. Read it first, every session.
- [README.md](README.md): what the kit is and how to run it.

## Guides

- [Start Here](docs/guides/start-here.md): What this kit is, and the five rules that matter before you write anything.
- [File Structure](docs/guides/file-structure.md): Where a file goes, and how to tell a component from a helper.
- [Forms](docs/guides/forms.md): React Hook Form + Zod + Field. Holds for every form, from one input to a hundred.
- [State URL](docs/guides/state-url.md): nuqs. What belongs in the URL, what stays in `useState`, and the Suspense trap.
- [Responsive](docs/guides/responsive.md): Phone width is the default. What keeps breaking, and how to check it.
- [Libraries](docs/guides/libraries.md): One library per job, wrapped once. The table, and what each wrapper owns.
- [Styling](docs/guides/styling.md): Tailwind v4, the token set, and the Base UI data attributes you style against.
- [Writing UI Copy](docs/guides/writing-ui-copy.md): Labels, descriptions and errors. When a line of help text earns its place.

## UI components

Written by `shadcn add`, on the `base-rhea` style (Base UI, not Radix). Never hand-edit one; run `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <name> --overwrite` instead.

- [Accordion](docs/ui/accordion.md): Sections that fold away, stacked vertically. Base UI drives it, so the open/closed state reads as `data-open` on the item and the panel exposes its measured height as a CSS variable — a transition needs no JavaScript measuring.
- [Alert](docs/ui/alert.md): A message that sits in the page, not over it. `AlertAction` puts a control on the right of the same row. For something the person has to answer, use `alert-dialog`; for something that passes on its own, `toast`.
- [Alert Dialog](docs/ui/alert-dialog.md): A dialog that has to be answered — no dismissing by clicking outside or pressing Escape. Reach for it only when the action destroys something. `shared/confirm-dialog` already wraps it with the title, the description and the two buttons.
- [Aspect Ratio](docs/ui/aspect-ratio.md): Holds a box at a fixed ratio while its width changes, so an image or an embed does not shift the page as it loads.
- [Attachment](docs/ui/attachment.md): A file pinned to a message: thumbnail, name, size, and the controls to open or remove it. `AttachmentGroup` lays several out in a row.
- [Avatar](docs/ui/avatar.md): A person's picture, with initials behind it while the image loads or when there is none. `AvatarGroup` overlaps several and `AvatarGroupCount` closes the row with a `+3`.
- [Badge](docs/ui/badge.md): A short static label — a status, a count, a tag. It is not a button: if it can be clicked, it is a `Button` with `size="xs"`.
- [Breadcrumb](docs/ui/breadcrumb.md): The trail back up. Below `sm` the full trail wraps onto three lines, so collapse the ancestors into `BreadcrumbEllipsis` — this is one of the failures that shipped from this project before.
- [Bubble](docs/ui/bubble.md): One turn in a conversation. `BubbleGroup` stacks several from the same speaker, and the side is set by `data-align` on the wrapping `Message`, not by a prop on the bubble.
- [Button](docs/ui/button.md): Every clickable thing that is not a link, and — through `render` — links that look like buttons. Base UI takes `render={<Link href="/x" />}` where Radix took `asChild`. An icon inside wants `data-icon="inline-start"` or `data-icon="inline-end"`, which is what tightens the padding on that side.
- [Button Group](docs/ui/button-group.md): Buttons welded into one control, with the rounding and the shared borders handled. `ButtonGroupText` drops a static label into the strip, `ButtonGroupSeparator` a divider.
- [Calendar](docs/ui/calendar.md): The month grid, built on `react-day-picker`. On a screen, use `date-picker` instead — this is the surface it opens.
- [Card](docs/ui/card.md): A titled block of content. `CardAction` is the slot on the right of the header, which is where a menu or a link belongs rather than floated inside `CardTitle`.
- [Carousel](docs/ui/carousel.md): A horizontal track that scrolls one item at a time, on Embla. Every slide has to be reachable without the arrows, because on a phone they are the first thing to go.
- [Chart](docs/ui/chart.md): The Recharts wrapper: `ChartContainer` carries the config, `ChartStyle` turns each series colour into a CSS variable. Side-by-side panels leave about 190px each on a phone, which is not a chart any more — stack them.
- [Checkbox](docs/ui/checkbox.md): One box, on or off. In a form use `FormCheckbox`; for a set of them, `FormCheckboxGroup`, which owns the array value. Base UI marks state with `data-checked` and `data-indeterminate`, not `data-state`.
- [Collapsible](docs/ui/collapsible.md): One region that opens and closes. `accordion` is this with several regions and a shared rule about how many stay open.
- [Combobox](docs/ui/combobox.md): A select you can type into, with filtering and multi-select through `ComboboxChips`. In a form use `FormCombobox`. `useComboboxAnchor` is what pins the popup to something other than the input.
- [Command](docs/ui/command.md): The ⌘K palette, on cmdk. `CommandDialog` is the same list inside a dialog. The keyboard hint in `CommandShortcut` is for people with keyboards — drop it on a phone rather than letting the row overflow.
- [Context Menu](docs/ui/context-menu.md): The menu on right-click. It has no touch equivalent, so anything that lives only here is unreachable on a phone; repeat it in a `dropdown-menu` or a row action.
- [Data Table](docs/ui/data-table.md): The table recipe over `@tanstack/react-table` v9 — `tableFeatures()` and `useTable`, not the v8 API. Sorting, paging and column visibility go through nuqs, so pass `queryKey` and mount it inside `<Suspense>`. There is no registry item for this file; the CLI never touches it.
- [Date Picker](docs/ui/date-picker.md): The calendar in a popover, plus a range picker, a time picker and a natural-language input that parses "next friday" through chrono. It shows how to read the URL only when asked: `DateValue` splits into `QueryDate` and `LocalDate` so a caller without a `queryKey` never mounts the nuqs hook, and never drags a Suspense boundary along with it.
- [Dialog](docs/ui/dialog.md): A modal over the page. On a phone a dialog is worse than a sheet for anything taller than a couple of fields — `shared/responsive-dialog` picks between them for you.
- [Direction](docs/ui/direction.md): Base UI's `DirectionProvider`, re-exported. This project is `rtl: false`, so nothing mounts it; it is here because the registry ships it, and it is the hook to pull if that ever changes.
- [Drawer](docs/ui/drawer.md): The sheet that slides from the bottom and answers to a swipe. `DrawerSwipeHandle` is the grab bar that tells a thumb it can be dragged.
- [Dropdown Menu](docs/ui/dropdown-menu.md): The menu a button opens. Checkbox and radio items keep their own state, so they are the right home for a filter that is not worth a URL key. Its open state is transient — `useState`, never nuqs.
- [Empty](docs/ui/empty.md): The block shown where content would be. `shared/empty-state` is the version to reach for, with the icon, the sentence and the action already arranged.
- [Field](docs/ui/field.md): The layout every form control sits in: label, control, description, error, and the `data-invalid` flag they all key off. There is no `form` component in `base-rhea`; this replaced it. Do not compose it by hand — `shared/form-field` already owns the four wirings that are easy to get subtly wrong per field.
- [Hover Card](docs/ui/hover-card.md): A preview that opens on hover. Hover does not exist on a touch screen, so whatever is inside has to be reachable another way.
- [Input](docs/ui/input.md): The single-line text box. In a form, `FormInput` — never `Input` under a bare `Controller`.
- [Input Group](docs/ui/input-group.md): An input with things welded to it: an icon, a prefix, a button, a unit. `InputGroupInput` and `InputGroupTextarea` are the versions that know they are inside the group.
- [Input OTP](docs/ui/input-otp.md): The one-box-per-digit code field. In a form, `FormOTP`.
- [Item](docs/ui/item.md): A row: media on the left, title and description in the middle, actions on the right. It is the shape behind most lists here, and it beats hand-rolling a flex row per screen.
- [Kbd](docs/ui/kbd.md): A key as it is printed on a keyboard. `KbdGroup` joins a chord. It is decoration for people with keyboards — it earns no space on a phone.
- [Label](docs/ui/label.md): The label element. Inside a form it comes from `FieldLabel`, which is already tied to the control's id by `shared/form-field`.
- [Marker](docs/ui/marker.md): A quiet line between blocks of content — a timestamp in a chat, a "3 unread" rule. The `separator` variant draws the line through the middle of the text.
- [Menubar](docs/ui/menubar.md): The desktop-application menu strip. It assumes a pointer and a wide window; on a phone the same commands belong in a `dropdown-menu`.
- [Message](docs/ui/message.md): One entry in a conversation: avatar, header, bubbles, footer. `data-align` on the group is what sends everything to the right for the person's own turns.
- [Message Scroller](docs/ui/message-scroller.md): The scroll behaviour a chat needs — pinned to the bottom, staying put when the person scrolls up, and a button back down. The hooks report whether the viewport is scrollable and whether the newest message is in view.
- [Native Select](docs/ui/native-select.md): The browser's own `<select>`. On a phone it opens the platform picker, which is faster and more accessible than any popup. Use `FormNativeSelect` for a plain list of options and keep `Select` for the cases that need custom rows.
- [Navigation Menu](docs/ui/navigation-menu.md): The site-level menu with panels that open under it. `NavigationMenuPositioner` is where the panel is placed; `navigationMenuTriggerStyle()` gives a plain link the trigger's look.
- [Pagination](docs/ui/pagination.md): The page strip. The page number belongs in the URL — `parseAsInteger.withDefault(1)` — so a refresh and a shared link both land on the same page.
- [Popover](docs/ui/popover.md): A panel anchored to a trigger, for content that is not a menu and not a form. Its open state is transient: `useState`, not nuqs, or a reload reopens it and the Back button fills with noise.
- [Progress](docs/ui/progress.md): A determinate bar. `ProgressLabel` and `ProgressValue` are the accessible text; for work with no known end, use `spinner`.
- [Questionnaire](docs/ui/questionnaire.md): The one-question-at-a-time flow from `@shadcn/react` — steps, progress, validation and the previous/next/skip controls. `examples/onboarding-questionnaire` is the working screen.
- [Radio Group](docs/ui/radio-group.md): One choice out of a visible few. In a form, `FormRadioGroup`. Past about six options a `Select` or a `Combobox` reads better.
- [Resizable](docs/ui/resizable.md): Draggable splits, on `react-resizable-panels`. Give every panel a `minSize` or a drag can hide one with nothing left to grab — and below `md` drop the split entirely: a drag target is an affordance no thumb can use.
- [Scroll Area](docs/ui/scroll-area.md): A box that scrolls with a styled bar. The page itself never scrolls sideways; this is how a genuinely wide element scrolls inside its own edges.
- [Select](docs/ui/select.md): The custom dropdown, for options that need more than a line of text. For a plain list, `native-select` is the better phone experience. In a form, `FormSelect`. `aria-invalid` goes on the trigger, which is what a person focuses.
- [Separator](docs/ui/separator.md): A rule between things. Decorative by default, so it stays out of the accessibility tree.
- [Sheet](docs/ui/sheet.md): The panel that slides in from an edge. It is the phone answer to a dialog with more than a couple of fields, and `shared/responsive-dialog` swaps to it automatically.
- [Sidebar](docs/ui/sidebar.md): The whole navigation shell: provider, rail, collapsible states, the mobile sheet, and `SidebarInset` for the page beside it. `useSidebar` is how a button elsewhere closes it — which it has to, on a tap, or the sheet stays over the page it just navigated to.
- [Skeleton](docs/ui/skeleton.md): The grey shape standing in for content that is loading. Match the real element's size, or the page jumps when the content lands.
- [Slider](docs/ui/slider.md): A number picked by dragging. In a form, `FormSlider`. Give it a visible value nearby: a thumb hides the exact number under the finger.
- [Spinner](docs/ui/spinner.md): Indeterminate work. Once you know the proportion done, `progress` says more.
- [Switch](docs/ui/switch.md): A setting that takes effect immediately, with no Save between. If the change only lands on submit, it is a `checkbox`. Base UI marks it with `data-checked`.
- [Table](docs/ui/table.md): The bare table elements. For anything with sorting, paging or column visibility, use `data-table` instead of rebuilding them. A table is the one element allowed to scroll sideways, inside its own `overflow-x` box.
- [Tabs](docs/ui/tabs.md): Sections behind one strip. `TabsList` is `h-8` under a `group-data-horizontal` variant, so a plain `h-auto` does not override it and a wrapped second row spills over what is below — nine tabs come to 600px. Wrap the list, do not scroll it. The active tab belongs in the URL; `shared/query-tabs` does that.
- [Textarea](docs/ui/textarea.md): Multi-line text. In a form, `FormTextarea`.
- [Toast](docs/ui/toast.md): The transient message, bottom of the screen. `sonner` is gone from `base-rhea` and this replaced it. Do not import the manager here — `lib/notify.ts` owns the singleton, and every screen calls that.
- [Toggle](docs/ui/toggle.md): A button that stays pressed. One of them alone is usually a `switch` or a `checkbox` wearing a button's clothes; the honest use is inside a `toggle-group`.
- [Toggle Group](docs/ui/toggle-group.md): A row of toggles acting as one control — single or multiple. In a form, `FormToggleGroup`.
- [Tooltip](docs/ui/tooltip.md): A label for a control that shows only an icon. It never carries information that is not repeated elsewhere: there is no hover on a touch screen.
- [Typography](docs/ui/typography.md): The heading, paragraph and list styles as components, for content this project renders itself. No registry item — it is a composition recipe and the CLI never touches it.

## Shared components

Ours. The standardized pieces a screen composes from, built on top of `ui/`. Start here before reaching for a primitive.

- [Confirm Dialog](docs/shared/confirm-dialog.md): Asks before something that is hard to undo.
- [Copy Button](docs/shared/copy-button.md): Copies a value and says so.
- [Country Flag](docs/shared/country-flag.md): A country's flag, as a real SVG file.
- [Currency Input](docs/shared/currency-input.md): Money input that works in cents.
- [Document Input](docs/shared/document-input.md): CPF or CNPJ in one field. With `kind="auto"` the mask widens from CPF to CNPJ once the value passes eleven characters, so a form that takes either does not make the person choose first. CNPJ carries letters in its first twelve positions under RFB technical note 49/2024, which is why this cannot be a digits-only mask.
- [Empty State](docs/shared/empty-state.md): What a list shows before it has anything in it.
- [Error State](docs/shared/error-state.md): A failure a person can act on.
- [Form](docs/shared/form.md): The one way a form is set up here: a Zod schema in, a typed form out.
- [Form Actions](docs/shared/form-actions.md): The row a form ends on.
- [Form Address Fields](docs/shared/form-address-fields.md): Country, state and city as one dependent chain.
- [Form Checkbox](docs/shared/form-checkbox.md): A single boolean.
- [Form Checkbox Group](docs/shared/form-checkbox-group.md): Any number of a set, stored as an array of values.
- [Form Combobox](docs/shared/form-combobox.md): A long list you search rather than scroll.
- [Form Currency Input](docs/shared/form-currency-input.md): An amount, held in cents for the whole round trip.
- [Form Date Picker](docs/shared/form-date-picker.md): A single date.
- [Form Date Range Picker](docs/shared/form-date-range-picker.md): A start and an end date, held as one `DateRange` value.
- [Form Document Input](docs/shared/form-document-input.md): CPF or CNPJ, masked as it is typed and checked by `documentSchema`.
- [Form Field](docs/shared/form-field.md): Every field in this project renders through here.
- [Form File Input](docs/shared/form-file-input.md): Files, listed as they are picked.
- [Form Input](docs/shared/form-input.md): Single-line text. The default field, and the one most forms are made of.
- [Form Native Select](docs/shared/form-native-select.md): The platform's own select.
- [Form OTP](docs/shared/form-otp.md): A one-time code.
- [Form Password Input](docs/shared/form-password-input.md): A password, wired to the form. Rules belong in `passwordSchema`.
- [Form Phone Input](docs/shared/form-phone-input.md): Phone number, formatted for the country as it is typed.
- [Form Radio Group](docs/shared/form-radio-group.md): One of several, all visible at once.
- [Form Select](docs/shared/form-select.md): A closed list of options.
- [Form Slider](docs/shared/form-slider.md): A number picked from a range.
- [Form Switch](docs/shared/form-switch.md): A setting that takes effect as it is flipped.
- [Form Textarea](docs/shared/form-textarea.md): Multi-line text, for anything a person writes in sentences.
- [Form Toggle Group](docs/shared/form-toggle-group.md): A handful of options, all on screen, chosen by pressing one.
- [Loading State](docs/shared/loading-state.md): Placeholder rows shaped like the content that is coming.
- [Masked Input](docs/shared/masked-input.md): A text input that formats as you type against a pattern.
- [Menu Section](docs/shared/menu-section.md): A labelled block of menu items.
- [Page Header](docs/shared/page-header.md): The top of a screen: where you are, and what you can do from here.
- [Password Input](docs/shared/password-input.md): A password field with a reveal toggle.
- [Phone Input](docs/shared/phone-input.md): Phone input driven by libphonenumber-js rather than a pattern.
- [Query Tabs](docs/shared/query-tabs.md): Tabs whose active panel lives in the URL.
- [Responsive Dialog](docs/shared/responsive-dialog.md): A dialog on a pointer, a drawer on a phone.
- [Search Input](docs/shared/search-input.md): A search box whose term lives in the URL.
- [Section](docs/shared/section.md): A titled block within a page, so screens stack the same way.
- [Sidebar Avatar Button](docs/shared/sidebar-avatar-button.md): A sidebar row that leads with an avatar — a workspace switcher, an account menu.
- [Sidebar Nav Button](docs/shared/sidebar-nav-button.md): A sidebar item that closes the sidebar behind it on a phone. On mobile the sidebar is a sheet over the page, so a destination that leaves it open hides the very thing you navigated to. Not for a row that opens a menu or expands a group — those stay open on purpose.
- [Stat Card](docs/shared/stat-card.md): One number, with the context that makes it mean something.
- [Submit Button](docs/shared/submit-button.md): The button that sends a form.

## Example screens

Reference screens. Read one to see how the pieces fit together on a real page.

- [Account Settings](docs/examples/account-settings.md): A long settings form split across tabs, with the active tab in the URL. The one to read for how many field types coexist on one screen: text, textarea, combobox, file, OTP, password, switch, slider, checkbox group and toggle group, all under a single `useZodForm`.
- [App Sidebar](docs/examples/app-sidebar.md): The navigation shell: grouped sections from `constants/navigation.ts`, a collapsible group, the account menu at the foot. It taps `useSidebar` to close the sheet on navigation, which a phone needs or the panel stays over the page it just opened.
- [Booking Panel](docs/examples/booking-panel.md): A calendar beside the slots for the day it selects, paged. The pattern for a two-column layout that has to become one column on a phone.
- [Bug Report Form](docs/examples/bug-report-form.md): The long-hand version of a form — `Controller`, `Field`, `aria-invalid` and `FieldError` wired by hand. It stays as the reference for what `shared/form-field` does for you; a new screen should never look like this.
- [Checkout Form](docs/examples/checkout-form.md): The biggest form here: sections, an address chain that reloads states and cities as the country changes, CPF/CNPJ, phone, and a progress bar over the whole thing. Read it before building anything multi-step.
- [Feedback Playground](docs/examples/feedback-playground.md): Every way this project tells a person something — toast, confirm dialog, responsive dialog, popover, empty state, error state, loading state — on one page with the controls to fire them.
- [Onboarding Questionnaire](docs/examples/onboarding-questionnaire.md): One question per screen inside a responsive dialog: the `questionnaire` primitive driving progress, validation and skip.
- [Orders Table](docs/examples/orders-table.md): The `data-table` recipe on a real dataset — sorting, paging, column visibility and row selection, all in the URL, with a row detail in a sheet and a destructive action behind a confirm dialog.
- [Product Gallery](docs/examples/product-gallery.md): A carousel, hover previews and a context menu over a grid of cards. Also the reference for skeletons that match the shape of what is loading.
- [Release Notes](docs/examples/release-notes.md): A server-rendered content page: `typography` for prose, accordions for the older versions. It renders inside a client tab strip without becoming a client component itself.
- [Revenue Dashboard](docs/examples/revenue-dashboard.md): Charts, stat cards and a resizable split. The split is where the phone rules bite hardest — two panels leave about 190px each, so below the breakpoint it stacks and the drag handle goes away entirely.
- [Scenario Tabs](docs/examples/scenario-tabs.md): The strip that switches between the example screens. Panels arrive as `content` props rather than being rendered here, so a server component stays server-rendered inside a client tab.
- [Site Header](docs/examples/site-header.md): The top bar: breadcrumb, navigation menu, menubar, command palette and the sidebar trigger. The densest thing to fit on a phone, and the one that shows what gets dropped rather than squeezed.
- [Support Chat](docs/examples/support-chat.md): A conversation: message groups, bubbles, attachments, a day marker, the composer, and the scroller that stays pinned to the bottom without trapping someone reading further up.

## Library wrappers

One file per external library or service. Screens import the wrapper, never the library, so a format decision changes in one place.

- [Address](docs/lib/address.md): Countries, states and cities from the official Country State City database.
- [Date](docs/lib/date.md): One place for every date string the interface shows, so a format is chosen once rather than at each call site.
- [Document](docs/lib/document.md): CPF and CNPJ: the masks, the validation and the stripping. CNPJ takes letters in its first twelve positions under RFB technical note 49/2024, so a digits-only mask is wrong from July 2026 on.
- [Notify](docs/lib/notify.md): The four things a screen says after an action, in one place.
- [Phone](docs/lib/phone.md): Phone numbers, through libphonenumber-js. Formatting as you type, the E.164 string to store, the national string to show, validation and a per-country placeholder. Screens import this, never the library.
- [Search Params](docs/lib/search-params.md): Every nuqs parser this project uses, declared once and imported from `nuqs/server`. The same object feeds `useQueryStates` on the client, `createLoader` in a server component and `createSerializer` when building a link.

## Utilities

Pure helpers with no dependencies of their own.

- [Mask](docs/utils/mask.md): Drops everything the pattern would have inserted, leaving typed content.
- [Number](docs/utils/number.md): Money, percentages and counts. `Intl` handles the locale rules; these wrappers only fix the choices so every screen agrees.

## Hooks

React hooks.

- [Use Media Query](docs/hooks/use-media-query.md): Tracks a CSS media query from React.
- [Use Mobile](docs/hooks/use-mobile.md): Answers the one question most layouts ask — is this a phone. `useMediaQuery` is the general version, for a breakpoint that has nothing to do with touch.

## Schemas

Zod schemas, reused across forms.

- [Fields](docs/schemas/fields.md): Zod schemas that already know how our masked inputs store their values, so a form never re-states the same rule. Each one strips the mask before checking, and transforms to the shape an API should receive.

## Constants

Static data.

- [Navigation](docs/constants/navigation.md): Shared by the sidebar and the command menu, so the two never disagree.

## Server actions

Server actions.

- [Address](docs/actions/address.md): Countries, states and cities, reached from the browser.
